reading.action: Hold at the lit threshold of floor 4 to train control: send up as-small-and-controlled light-bolts, map the reachable shaft, continue until the hunter approaches or ~half focus spent. A/B/C-test channeling bolts through Burning Anger, the Furnace-heart, and directly.

checkA_control_drill_map.note: STRONG clean control drill. Tiny steady emberlight spots, learning to pinch them smaller; good partial map of the LOWER reachable shaft (first broken flights, the gaps, the nearest slabs and their beat, the lantern-bracket + oil flask at the first landing confirmed). Ember Channel SUB-THRESHOLD roll-up (Journeyman cont. 14.0->14.5) — deliberate fine-control practice, NOT routine; below the display threshold so NO visible skill change. No new skill emerges (needed a masterful margin). EXPENDITURE (throws ember OUT) -> NO affinity tick.

checkB_conduit_compare.note: SOLID read — three distinct conduit profiles grasped, actionable. DIRECT: precise + instant, costs HIS own focus (the limiter). BURNING ANGER: throws bolts FAR + BRIGHT but COARSE/fat, and drains the mace's modest charge FAST (a flare-thrower). FURNACE-HEART: feeds bolts from its OWN banked charge (spares his focus), steady + clean, sustainable for a long burn; the core cools slowly as it pays. -> the core is the SUSTAINED-light tool, the mace the far-flare tool, direct the precision tool.

reading.result: Control drill clean + productive; lower shaft partially MAPPED; three conduit profiles learned. The warmth-beacon DREW THE HUNTER: its idle circling firmed to purpose and it began coming for him at the threshold. A light-bolt CAUGHT it for one instant — a long pale low shape, eyes throwing the glare, flinching from the brightness — revealing that LIGHT REPELS IT, before it poured back into the dark and kept coming. No clean kill-view yet; Colossus + mid-shaft corpse still unseen. COST: Focus 102->70 (-32); Stamina flat; HP flat. Burning Anger charge now LOW; Furnace-heart charge LOWER (dimmer). No XP, no skill/affinity display change. He is crouched at the lip he chose to defend — re-bound (low) mace in one hand, cooling core in the other, ~2/3 focus — and the hunter has accepted the invitation. STOP. NO assumed next action. NO Tower reset.
